description: Ranks ETFs by estimated net creation/redemption in CNY over a 1/5/20 trading-day window. **An estimate** (`share change × that day's unit NAV`), not a reported flow, and **null is not 0**: uncomputable days (stale shares / NAV, share-conversion dates) are skipped — **read `valid_days` with the total**. ⚠️ Without `asset_class`, money-market ETFs dominate by one to two orders of magnitude; `asset_class=equity` fixes that but drops every Shanghai-listed fund.

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

asset_class.description: Shenzhen-only; use equity to keep money-market funds off the ranking

direction.description: in = largest net creation (default), out = largest net redemption

name: etf_flows
